description: Shield and imp-swarm - a demon knight who tanks behind a wall of summoned hellfire.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 41 real CoA Defiance talents (role Tank), completing Knight of Xoroth. Hellfire Resolve ports half - block from Strength is a legal conversion pair, hit_rating is not, the seventh time that has cost a node. NOTHING COUNTS HOW MANY PETS ARE ACTIVE and that is the spine of this spec: four CoA talents scale off live imp count and each is granted at a realistic three-imp value, flat. Pets never fire procs either, which takes Hellfire Reprimand entirely. The pet KEYS are live on this class though - it genuinely summons three pets. Owns shieldgore (t1) and call_hellfire_abyssal (t6), both gated, both asserted.

nodes.name: Hellfire Resolve
nodes.description: Increases your chance to block by 15% of your Strength and your chance to hit by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Increases your block rating by 15% of your Strength and increases your hit rating by 5% of your Strength.' THE BLOCK CONVERSION PORTS - `block` is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and strength is a source. THE HIT CONVERSION DOES NOT - hit_rating is not a target, the seventh time in this audit that pairing has cost a node half its text - so it is paid as a flat 5%. `block` is a PERCENT added to BASE_BLOCK_CHANCE and rolled against 0-100; block_chance is a DEAD key.

nodes.name: Hellfire Forgemaster
nodes.description: Increases your block value by 21%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your block value by 20%.' Ports exactly. block_value_pct is read RAW on BOTH sides of the talent/status divide - a FRACTION either way - unlike max_health_pct and healing_taken_pct which flip. Authoring 20.0 would be 2000%, which is what audit_talents caught on Guardian Vanguard's Iron Barrier earlier today.

nodes.name: A Gift from Hell
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike, Meatsaw and Melt by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike, Meatsaw, and Melt by -10.' All three abilities exist in Frontier and Rage is the class's real primary resource. A flat 10 is expressed as a percentage because costs differ per rank. POSITIVE reduces, so CoA's minus sign is dropped.

nodes.name: Hellsmelted Armor
nodes.description: Increases your chance to block by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Each Hellfire Imp active now increases your chance to block by 1%.' NOTHING COUNTS HOW MANY PETS ARE ACTIVE - pets scale off pet_damage/pet_health/pet_armor and nothing else, and no talent effect or payload reads a live pet count. A realistic field is three imps, so 1% x 3 imps x 2 ranks is 6%, flat. This is the first of four imp-count talents in this tree; each says so on its own node.

nodes.name: Imp Guards
nodes.description: Reduces the physical damage you take by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive: 'Each Hellfire Imp now reduces your Physical damage taken by 1%.' Same wall as Hellsmelted Armor - no live pet count is readable - so three imps at 1% is 3%, doubled to 6% because this is the spec's level 20 passive and should carry a node on its own. AS A TALENT EFFECT physical_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION where NEGATIVE reduces; inside a status effect the same key is divided by 100 and positive INCREASES damage taken.

nodes.name: Shieldgore
nodes.description: Teaches Shieldgore, goring the target with your shield for high threat.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Transforms your Infernal Strike into Shieldgore. Generates 2 Demonfire. Gore the target with your spiked shield, causing High Threat Fire Damage, scaling with your block value.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: knight_of_xoroth_shieldgore carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever - and it is also one of the four abilities that generate Deathfire (20 per cast), so losing it would cost the spec its resource engine too. Nothing transforms one ability into another, so it is granted alongside Infernal Strike. Kept at tier 1.

nodes.name: Bulwark of Xoroth
nodes.description: Shieldgore tears the flesh, bleeding the enemy for physical damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Shieldgore will now apply Torn Flesh, causing the target to bleed for 105 over 15 seconds.' PORTS CLEANLY - a bleed IS a dot, and 15 sec is 3 turns (held short so a tank's threat dot is not the longest in the class). Note the effect is a dot with a physical school rather than anything named 'bleed': `bleed_dot_damage` is a dead key, confirmed earlier in this audit when no ability id contained 'bleed'.

nodes.name: Demonfire Retaliation
nodes.description: Being attacked has a 30% chance to grant 10 Deathfire.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Grants you a 30% chance to generate a stack of Demonfire when attacked.' PORTS EXACTLY - on_damage_taken is a live trigger, CoA's 30% is kept, and DEATHFIRE IS A REAL SECONDARY RESOURCE (verified through gain_resource on the War tree). CoA's '1 stack' is 10 here because Frontier's generators work in tens - Sever grants 10, Infernal Strike 20 - so one CoA Demonfire is worth roughly ten Deathfire. A tank that makes resource by being hit is the same loop as Venomancer Fortitude's Exposed Flesh.

nodes.name: Hellish Rebuke
nodes.description: Being attacked has a 15% chance to erupt, splashing fire onto nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Generating a stack of Demon's Blood now has a 15% chance to trigger a fiery explosion on up to 5 nearby enemies, dealing Fire damage.' NO TRIGGER FIRES WHEN A RESOURCE IS GENERATED - there is no on-resource-gain hook - so it hangs off the same on_damage_taken that Demonfire Retaliation above uses, which is what generates the stack in practice. The two fire together, exactly as CoA intends. CoA's 15% kept; 1-turn icd.

nodes.name: Warden of Hellfire
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Skulltaker and Flames of Xoroth by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage dealt by Skulltaker and Flames of Xoroth by 20%.' Ports exactly - both exist in Frontier.

nodes.name: Imp Gang Boss
nodes.description: Increases the damage and health of your imps by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Call: Hellfire Imp now summons 2 additional imps.' NO KEY CHANGES HOW MANY PETS AN ABILITY SUMMONS - the count lives on the ability - so two more imps cannot be bought. Re-pointed at pet_damage and pet_health, which is a stronger swarm rather than a bigger one. THE KEYS ARE LIVE HERE because this class genuinely summons three pets; the same node on the Witch Doctor or Venomancer would have been dead data (see tools/qa_pet_keys.py).

nodes.name: Impcaller
nodes.description:
Infernal Strike has a 25% chance to call a Hellfire Imp to your
side, once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Transforms your Call: Hellfire Imp into Impcaller. Your Infernal Strike now summons a Hellfire Imp to aid you in combat for 10 seconds, but its Rage cost is increased by 10. In addition, the maximum health of your imps is increased by 30%.' THE SUMMON HALF PORTS - cast_ability takes a bare ability id, and Call: Hellfire Imp is auto-learned (not requires_talent), so it is in the book and can be cast by a payload. Held to 25% with a 2-turn icd rather than every strike, since a free imp per cast would swarm the field. No key ADDS a cost, so CoA's downside cannot be charged.

nodes.name: Hellfire Legion
nodes.description: Increases the health and armour of your imps by a further 30%.
nodes._source: CoA's Impcaller carries '+30% maximum health of your imps' as its third clause, which does not fit on the Impcaller node once that node is a proc - so it is split out here with armour alongside. CoA's 30% kept. NOT a separate CoA talent and flagged as such; it is the remainder of one.

nodes.name: Sacrificial Circle
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Sacrificial Circle by 27% and reduces its cooldown by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Sacrifice your Hellfire Imps within 15 yds, healing you 15% of your maximum health, plus an additional amount equal to 25% of each of your Hellfire Imp's maximum health.' Frontier HAS Sacrificial Circle and it is not gated. The per-imp scaling needs a live pet count, which nothing reads, so it lives on the ability's own coefficients; the talent makes the whole thing bigger and more frequent instead. Corpses are not modelled.

nodes.name: Soul Furnace
nodes.description: Sacrificial Circle shields you for 20% of the healing it does.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Sacrificial Circle now grants you a damage absorption shield equal to 15% of the total health of each destroyed imp for 10 sec.' The per-imp scaling needs a pet count nothing reads, but shield_pct IS a live payload that converts a share of the triggering HEAL into an absorb - and Sacrificial Circle is a heal, so the shield scales off something real. A FRACTION.

nodes.name: Demon's Breath
nodes.description: Your critical strikes with Shieldgore erupt for fire damage and grant 10 Deathfire.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes with Shieldgore now unleash an eruption of hellfire, causing Fire damage and generating 1 additional Demonfire.' PORTS WHOLE - a proc can carry BOTH a damage_flat payload and a grant_resource, so both halves of CoA's text fire from one node. CoA's '1 Demonfire' is 10 Deathfire, matching Frontier's tens-based generators.

nodes.name: Infernal Bulwark
nodes.description: Unleash Pestilence raises your block value by 20% for 6 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Unleash Pestilence now generates 4 stacks of Demonfire and grants Infernal Bulwark. Increases block value by 20% for 18 sec.' The block buff ports exactly - CoA's 20%, and 18 sec is 6 turns. A proc carries ONE grant_resource and this one spends it on the buff, so the 4 Demonfire is dropped; two other nodes in this tree already grant Deathfire. BLOCK_VALUE_PCT IS READ RAW inside a status effect as well as outside, so 20% is 0.20 - the flip that audit_talents caught on Guardian Vanguard.

nodes.name: Stoke the Flames
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Skulltaker and Melt by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Skulltaker and Melt used with 6 Demonfire now refund 2 Demonfire. Skulltaker used with 6 Demonfire now deals an additional 30% Fire damage.' NOTHING READS A LIVE RESOURCE AMOUNT, so 'used with 6 Demonfire' cannot gate anything and the refund cannot be conditioned. CoA's 30% is granted unconditionally on both abilities.

nodes.name: Implosion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Implosion by 21% and reduces its cooldown by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Explode with hellish fire, dealing Fire damage to nearby enemies, beckoning Hellfire Imps to aid you in battle for 12 sec, and generating 30 Rage. Deals increased damage and increases the amount of imps summoned by 1 for each Demonfire consumed.' Frontier HAS Implosion and it is not gated. The per-Demonfire scaling needs a live resource read and the imp count lives on the ability, so neither is buildable. CoA's Demonfire Command ('reduces the cooldown of Implosion by -10 sec and its Rage cost by -5') is folded in as the 25% rather than built as a second node for one ability's cooldown.

nodes.name: Hellfire Reprimand
nodes.description: Your strikes leave the enemy dealing 15% less damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Hellfire Imps now have a 20% chance on hit to launch a firebolt dealing Fire damage and reducing enemy attack power for 10 sec.' PETS NEVER FIRE PROCS - there is no fire_proc_trigger anywhere in entities/pet.py - so an imp cannot have a chance-on-hit at all, which makes this talent unbuildable as written. Re-pointed at the Knight's own strikes carrying the attack-power debuff, which is the mitigation the firebolts bought a tank. 10 sec is 3 turns. damage_dealt_pct inside a status effect is percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Brimstone Knight
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 3%, and your strikes leave the enemy taking 10% more spell damage for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your Fire damage dealt by 3% and dealing Fire damage increases the enemy spell damage taken by 10% for 15 sec.' BOTH HALVES PORT, with the per-school scoping dropped (no per-school damage key, and no trigger-side school filter - proc['school'] only types a damage_flat payload). CoA's 3% and 10% both kept; 15 sec is 5 turns.

nodes.name: Speed Demon
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 9%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Suffuse now increases your movement speed by 20%.' MOVEMENT SPEED IS NOT MODELLED and there is no 'while Suffuse is active' gate either. Rerouted to haste, which is what speed means in a turn-based fight - acting more often. NOT a faithful copy and flagged as such, the same treatment as Templar Crusader's Whirling Tempest.

nodes.name: Demonic Fortitude
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 12% and your armour by 15%.
nodes._source: Built from CoA's Hellsmelted Armor and Imp Guards themes - both of which lost their per-imp scaling - so tier 5 carries a real tank stat node. NOT a port of a specific CoA talent and flagged as such. Both keys take percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Legion's Presence
nodes.description: Increases the threat you generate by 30% and reduces the physical damage you take by a further 9%.
nodes._source: Frontier HAS Legion's Presence as a target_type 'party' ability - the class's only party-targeted one - and it is not gated, so this is not its unlock. Built as the threat and mitigation a tank capstone tier wants, stacking with Imp Guards at tier 0 for 14% physical reduction on a full Defiance build. threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE increases, the opposite polarity to the _cost_pct family beside it.

nodes.name: Call: Hellfire Abyssal
nodes.description: Teaches Call: Hellfire Abyssal, and your demons hit 16% harder.
nodes._source: LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: knight_of_xoroth_call_hellfire_abyssal carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. It completes Knight of Xoroth's five gated abilities - Gore and Brimstone Bludgeon in War, Hellmaw in Hellfire, Shieldgore and this in Defiance - and main() asserts both of this tree's. The pet damage is added because a capstone granting only an ability is thin, and it pays off the swarm the whole tree builds: with Imp Gang Boss and Hellfire Legion it reaches 80% pet damage on a full Defiance build. The key is live because this class really summons.
